audience: IT and email administrators who check DNS records, blacklists and mail monitors in MxToolbox

useCases.title: Check a domain's SPF, DKIM and DMARC records
useCases.text: Run a DNS lookup such as MX, SPF, DKIM or DMARC for a domain. Read the passed, warning and failed checks.

useCases.title: Check an IP address against blacklists
useCases.text: Run a blacklist lookup for an IP address or a domain. Other network checks, such as SMTP, ping and TCP, are also available.

useCases.title: Review monitors and their failing checks
useCases.text: List the monitors on the account with their status, failing checks and warnings. Filter them by tag.

useCases.title: See how many lookups are left today
useCases.text: Show the simple and network lookups used today, and the daily maximum for each.
